projects.description:
A maintenance timeline, update queue and backup overview explore a straightforward way to communicate ongoing website care.

Give a business owner a clear view of routine website care. The proposed scope includes update history, backup overview, maintenance requests and monthly summaries.

This sample case study demonstrates how a completed project can be presented. The figures and client are illustrative, and the video is placeholder footage.
